items.title: Kerala estate turns 90% wild, elephants and tigers return
items.author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
items.description: In 1995, Ahmed Chamanwala took ownership of a plantation that has since transformed into a sanctuary for rewilding and conservation efforts. Struggling against poaching and illegal activities initially, the estate transitioned towards eco-tourism. Today, approximately 90% of the property serves as a wildlife refuge, nurturing various species. Despite facing legal hurdles, Chamanwala remains steadfast in his mission to preserve this vital tract of land for nature.
